selection_policy: Rank sources for technical qualification only on data integrity, chronology, identity, coverage, reliability and reproducibility. Rights/licensing metadata never blocks technical qualification. Active LevLine research remains zero-cost, so paid feeds are not used by the current pipeline; production promotion remains a separate explicit decision.
